message: PAYMENT_DNS_NO_ADDRESS synthetic health check for a secondary dependency did not resolve an address.

AUTH_REJECT_SPIKE the verifier returned additional HTTP 401 responses.
JWKS_KID_UNKNOWN validly formatted tokens presented key identifiers missing from the cached signing-key set.
JWKS_REFRESH_FAILED the signing-key set refresh returned a temporary upstream error.

JWKS_REFRESH_FAILED identity could not refresh its signing-key cache.
